readings: Join riskandmargin to orders on ordervault = recordvault, ignoring unmatched records. For each ordertune, count the DISTINCT orders (distinct recordvault) that have at least one matching risk/margin record. Take the average of these counts across order types. For the types whose count is above that average, return one row with the average of their counts and the average of (count minus overall average), unrounded.

Join riskandmargin to orders on ordervault = recordvault, ignoring unmatched records. For each ordertune, count the matched joined rows, meaning risk/margin records. An order with several risk/margin records is counted once per record. Take the average of these counts across order types. For the types whose count is above that average, return one row with the average of their counts and the average of (count minus overall average), unrounded.
queries:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS cnt
  FROM riskandmargin r
  JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.ordertune
),
a AS (
  SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM c
)
SELECT AVG(c.cnt) AS avg_count_above, AVG(c.cnt - a.avg_cnt) AS avg_diff
FROM c, a
WHERE c.cnt > a.avg_cnt;

WITH c AS (
  SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM riskandmargin r
  JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.ordertune
),
a AS (
  SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM c
)
SELECT AVG(c.cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(c.cnt - a.avg_cnt) AS avg_diff
FROM c, a
WHERE c.cnt > a.avg_cnt
